metadata.name: Metadata index for associated data files from Pangaea publication El_Bizri-etal_2019
metadata.description: This dataset serves as a metadata catalog for three associated data files from the Pangaea publication by El Bizri et al. (2019). It lists file names, formats, sizes, and download URLs for archives containing pregnancy diagnosis interviews, pacas hunting records, and catch-per-unit-effort (CPUE) records.
